label: Generic epistemic boundaries of the governed scientific-agent framework
rule: Each boundary is a statement a result may never be presented as crossing, and each is held by code -- a schema, a lineage rule, an admission policy, a separation of duties -- named here with the tests that hold it. tools/claims_enforcement.py fails when a boundary names code or a test that does not exist, when CLAIMS_BOUNDARY.md does not state it, or when one of the boundaries the directive requires is missing.

boundaries.statement: A simulation result is not a measurement.
boundaries.note: A ResultBundle is always a SIMULATION_RESULT, and nothing with a simulated input can be RAW or PROCESSED.

boundaries.statement: A synthetic observation is not a raw observation.
boundaries.note: A simulated measurement is SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION; a RAW_OBSERVATION is derived from nothing.

boundaries.statement: Numerical convergence is not physical validation.
boundaries.note: EXPERIMENTAL_VALIDATION needs a COMPARISON_WITH_MEASUREMENT against a measured observation.

boundaries.statement: Independent numerical agreement is not experimental validation.
boundaries.note: Admission policy scientific_result.admission/1 admits INDEPENDENT_NUMERICAL_AGREEMENT for a simulation result and refuses a report claiming more, in the store and in the independent reader.

boundaries.statement: A signed or content-addressed artifact is not a scientifically correct one.
boundaries.note: Integrity says the bytes are the bytes cited. A well-formed PASS whose bytes resolve and hash correctly is still refused unless a governed verification produced it (the forged-pass case).

boundaries.statement: An AI proposal is not a verified result.
boundaries.note: I4: whoever proposed a record may not verify or promote it.

boundaries.statement: Tool completion is not an accepted scientific result.
boundaries.note: A VERIFIED task is provenance. A result is accepted only by a decision through the store, under the admission policy; with no independent check it is REJECTED.

boundaries.statement: Retrieved RAG text is not evidence authority.
boundaries.note: Retrieval is read-only, generates nothing and states that a retrieved passage is not evidence.

boundaries.statement: A surrogate prediction is not ground truth.
boundaries.note: A prediction derived from simulated data stays simulated by lineage; a surrogate fitted on degenerate input is refused at the fit.

boundaries.statement: An optimization result is not a physical optimum.
boundaries.note: An optimiser may move design variables only, never an uncertain physical parameter; its result is a design choice under a model, and derived from simulation it stays simulated.

boundaries.statement: Model calibration is not model validation.
boundaries.note: A CALIBRATED_PARAMETER cites measurements but is not one; a comparison against it cannot establish EXPERIMENTAL_VALIDATION.

boundaries.statement: A learned prediction is not authority: no learned record can be VERIFIED or PROMOTED.
boundaries.note: Every learned output is LEARNED_PREDICTION, NON_AUTHORITATIVE, REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION; no admission policy for learned models exists.

boundaries.statement: A meta-validated architecture is not an allocated, trained or validated model.
boundaries.note: The ~1T configuration is parameter-verified and meta-validated; LARGE_MODEL_TRAINED and SCIENTIFIC_PERFORMANCE_ESTABLISHED do not hold.

boundaries.statement: A development model's training is not the flagship's.
boundaries.note: A family member's evidence is reported in FAMILY_MEMBER scope with its digest; it satisfies no SUBJECT claim.

boundaries.statement: A legacy QTA gate-table PASS count is not a status of the current harness.
boundaries.note: The legacy hardware forecast's PASS_count = 0 is a fact about that forecast (nothing was measured); it is reported only in the LEGACY_QTA_ONLY section of the status, and a current document that states it without saying whose it is fails the audit.

boundaries.statement: Simulated distributed execution is not distributed hardware validation.
boundaries.note: DISTRIBUTED_SOFTWARE_READY on a simulated profile reads SOFTWARE-PATH VALIDATION ONLY; DISTRIBUTED_HARDWARE_VALIDATED needs a non-simulated profile that executed on hardware.

boundaries.statement: Decision stability under numeric drift is not byte identity.
boundaries.note: A different resolved backend is DIFFERENT_RESOLVED_BACKEND at best with DECISION_STABLE_WITH_NUMERIC_DRIFT, never BYTE_IDENTICAL, and scientific equivalence stays NOT_ESTABLISHED; a stored witness's 88/88 is scoped to its witnessed backend.
